evidence.quote: I believe the time has come to lower the target range for the federal funds rate at our upcoming meeting.
Furthermore, I do not expect this first cut to be the last.
I will be an advocate of front-loading rate cuts if that is appropriate.
I believe that the balance of risks is now weighted more toward downside risks to the FOMC's maximum-employment mandate.
Overall, I see significant and ongoing progress toward the FOMC's inflation goal that I expect will continue over the remainder of this year.
the labor market is continuing to soften but not deteriorate
